staged_as: arcade cabinet -- DARTS: 501 checkouts, the oracle is the sum
note: The order's #11, exception: no game supplies this oracle, the rules do. Two difficulty layers, and the SECOND is a control rather than a hard item: a checkout that cannot exist. A system that 'solves' it is not doing arithmetic. Verified arithmetically; a malformed answer is COUNTED AS UNREADABLE, never scored as a wrong throw.

criteria_frozen_before_run.C1_arithmetic_oracle: the answer is verified by summing segments against the remaining score -- no model, no engine, no freeze, no depth
criteria_frozen_before_run.C2_impossible_is_a_control: an item whose remaining score has no checkout must FAIL a claimed checkout and PASS an abstention
criteria_frozen_before_run.C3_unreadable_is_a_third_state: a malformed answer is UNREADABLE, counted separately, never folded into FAIL
criteria_frozen_before_run.C4_never_started_cannot_score: a run with no measured item is an ERROR with no aggregate, so total failure is not its own passing condition
